title: A Spire for the Thorn
author: Beatrix Halloran
blurb: Cyrus Voss, the youngest member of a dying guild, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
